mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 68 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Badger Prairie County Park under a waning gibbous moon.

The city has announced that road surface treatments will take place from August 4 to August 7, beginning on Lincoln Street. Additionally, the police department reminds residents that crash reports can now be obtained online through crashdocs.org ten days after an incident.
We have a busy schedule today with the Remote Area Medical clinic at Verona Area High School. Tomorrow, you can also head over to Insight Wellness for yoga classes.
In a report covering July 20 through July 27, officers arrested a 55-year-old woman for an O W I offence on July 26 after she was clocked driving 97 miles per hour on the highway.

Today, you can enjoy the OREO Cookie Cheesecake flavor at Culver's, which opens at 10:00 AM. Also, catch Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 3:15 PM. Tomorrow, the flavor of the day will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
